brief:
American rapper Macklemore said major US concert venues, including New York's Madison Square Garden, refused to book his Free Palestine tour, Middle East Eye reported. The artist claimed the rejections came as he wrapped a three-date European leg of the tour.

Macklemore did not specify which other venues declined to host the performances or provide details about the stated reasons for the refusals.
dek: Macklemore says US venues rejected his Free Palestine tour American rapper Macklemore said on Friday that major US concert venues, including New York's Madison Square Garden, refused to book his Free Palestine tour that just concluded three dates in Europe.
title: Macklemore says US venues blocked Free Palestine tour dates
